bio: Mindy Phan (she/her) is a first-year student at Harvard College living in Canaday Hall. She plans to concentrate in History and Literature with a focus on Ethnic Studies. Originally from West Valley City, Utah, she is the proud daughter of two Vietnamese immigrants who inspire her to embrace her cultural heritage and first-generation, low-income background. Through her involvement with the Harvard Foundation, the Harvard Vietnamese Association, and PBHA’s Chinatown Afterschool Program, Mindy hopes to help uplift and bring visibility to students from all backgrounds. At the Foundation, she assists with graphic design, marketing, and outreach. Area Harvard Foundation
